trace.title: Related content and changes
trace.description: Links record correspondence. Review changes to keep requirements and specifications aligned; linking does not prove correctness.
trace.noPair: Open and save an informal and a hybrid document in this project to use links.
trace.empty: No links in this view. Add a link or find suggestions.
trace.conflictHint: Both sides changed. Compare the differences and explicitly choose which side to update.
trace.reviewNote: Why is no further update needed?
trace.unlinkedHint: Items without confirmed links. Choose one to add a link.
trace.stalePreview: Content or links changed after this preview. Generate a new suggestion before applying.
trace.noEdits: AI suggested no changes. Edit manually or acknowledge this notification.
trace.applyHint: Apply only the selected changes. A partial application keeps this link pending. Other affected links remain pending. Ctrl+Z restores content and link metadata together.
trace.childCoverage: Leaf requirements linked: {count} / {total} (not a coverage proof)
trace.graphHint: Click either endpoint to navigate. Dashed lines are suggestions; amber lines need checking. Up to 100 links; narrow the scope for more.
trace.rebindHint: Choose new endpoints for each existing link. Nothing is reassigned automatically. Empty assignments require an explicit unlink choice; new links need review.
trace.recoveryHint: An interrupted or unsaved update can be restored.
trace.tokenHint: Ordinary editing uses local analysis. AI runs only when requested. Token counts are estimates including cached context; interrupted runs reuse completed cache entries.
trace.mergeHint: Compare and resolve concurrent review decisions before applying. No source text is modified.
trace.structureHint: Select one leaf requirement to split, or multiple sibling leaves to merge. Preview source changes, then assign every affected relationship. One undo restores both content and links.
trace.relocationCount: Preserve {matched} identities; {unmatched} items still need manual checking.
trace.sourceMissing: The related item was removed. Your content is preserved.
trace.bothEdited: Both sides were edited. AI will preview changes to this side; check your existing edits.
trace.boundAutomatically: The system maintains this connection. Click the name to navigate.
trace.changeAcknowledged: Change acknowledged; consistency has not been confirmed.
trace.previewOnly: Preview does not change your text. Applied changes can be undone; unselected changes remain pending.
trace.autoBindingHint: Agent modeling records provenance automatically. No separate link review is needed.
trace.recoverHint: Find connections in an existing project without changing specification text.
trace.localChangeNotified: This side was edited. Related content receives the change notification.
